summary: Suggestion animation playground and quieter voice capture

changes.title: Three selectable QuickType-inspired animations
changes.detail: Scale adds per-character growth and compression, Spring retains visible x/y momentum when interrupted, and Ripple staggers character appearance. Classic preserves the prior dissolve. Select in Motion Settings without changing prediction logic or global keyboard motion.

changes.title: Real-renderer suggestion playground
changes.detail: Replay identical synthetic suggestion sequences using the actual animation engine, then use the private live keyboard tryout to compare presets. Selection persists and applies to ordinary typing.

changes.title: Pause background media while recording
changes.detail: Both tap and hold microphone capture paths request exclusive transient Android audio focus and release it when the microphone closes, not when transcription completes. Android or the player may deny or ignore focus; recording continues safely if denied. No global volume or permission changes.
